segmente.text: People don't buy the best product. They buy the product they like best. If you don't understand
this and you don't focus on the right messaging, your business is preconditioned to fail. People
only care about your product if they understand the outcome. People don't buy the drill to have
it in the wall, but to hang the beautiful family painting that they will daily see and be proud
